title: Protection & Covering
intro: There is no year in which a parent prays this more. This month says the frightening thing plainly — that we cannot make the world safe — and then says the truer thing, that this child is covered by someone who does not sleep and does not leave.

keyScriptures.text: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge.
He who watches over you will not slumber... will neither slumber nor sleep.

weeks.title: Watched Over All Night
weeks.declaration: Someone is awake on your behalf every night of your life, and He does not get tired.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, watch over this child tonight. Let us sleep because You do not. Amen.

weeks.title: We Cannot, but He Can
weeks.declaration: There are things we cannot keep from you. There is nothing He cannot walk you through.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, we are afraid of what we cannot protect them from. Take that fear and keep this child. Amen.

weeks.title: Covered Where We Are Not
weeks.declaration: You are covered in the rooms we are not in, and there will be more of those every year.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, go where we cannot. Be nearer to this child than we could ever be. Amen.

weeks.title: Kept
weeks.declaration: You are kept. Not merely watched — kept, the way something precious is kept, by someone who fully intends to hold on.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, keep this child all their life. Keep them when they are far from us. Amen.

days.title: Watched All Night
days.declaration: Someone is awake for you every night, and He never needs to rest.

scripture.text: He will neither slumber nor sleep.

days.title: Under His Wings
days.declaration: There is shelter over you, close enough to reach at any hour.

scripture.text: Under his wings you will find refuge.

days.title: Safe to Sleep
days.declaration: You can sleep deeply. You are not the one holding the night together.

scripture.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

days.title: Hemmed In
days.declaration: You are surrounded — behind, before, and over. There is no gap in it.

scripture.text: You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand upon me.

days.title: Carried Everywhere
days.declaration: Everywhere you go this year, you are carried. Later you will walk, and still be accompanied.

scripture.text: The Lord your God carried you.

days.title: Angels Sent
days.declaration: Help you cannot see has been sent. You are looked after more than anyone can tell.

scripture.text: He will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

days.title: Not Ours to Hold Alone
days.declaration: We are not holding you alone. That is the only reason we can put you down.

scripture.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

days.title: A Shield Around
days.declaration: There is a shield around you that goes where you go.

scripture.text: But you, Lord, are a shield around me.

days.title: Hard Things Still Come
days.declaration: Being covered does not mean nothing hard happens. It means nothing happens to you alone.

scripture.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you.

days.title: Kept in Sickness
days.declaration: When you are unwell, you are held closer. He is not distant from a sick child.

scripture.text: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed.

days.title: Every Coming and Going
days.declaration: You are watched when you leave and when you come back, all your life.

scripture.text: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

days.title: Nothing Surprises Him
days.declaration: Nothing about today or any day catches God out. He is already there.

scripture.text: I make known the end from the beginning.

days.title: Home as Shelter
days.declaration: This home is meant to be a shelter for you. We are building it that way on purpose.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

days.title: Guarded Heart
days.declaration: Your heart will be guarded long before you know it needs guarding.

scripture.text: Above all else, guard your heart.

days.title: Peace Standing Guard
days.declaration: There is a peace that stands guard over a mind. May it stand over yours all your life.

scripture.text: The peace of God will guard your hearts and your minds.

days.title: Held When You Fall
days.declaration: When you fall — and you will, often, this year — you are not dropped.

scripture.text: The Lord upholds him with his hand.

days.title: A Strong Tower
days.declaration: There is somewhere to run that cannot be knocked down. May you always know the way there.

scripture.text: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower.

days.title: Never Abandoned
days.declaration: You will never be abandoned. Not when you are difficult, not when you are grown, not ever.

scripture.text: Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.

days.title: Protected From What We Cannot See
days.declaration: You have already been kept from things nobody will ever tell you about.

scripture.text: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble.

days.title: Rescued, Not Rescued From
days.declaration: God does not always take the hard thing away. He goes through it, which is better.

scripture.text: When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned.

days.title: Our Fear Handed Over
days.declaration: Our fear for you is not a good guardian. He is. We are handing it over.

scripture.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

days.title: Kept Through Growing
days.declaration: Everything about you is changing. You are held steady through all of it.

scripture.text: I the Lord do not change.

days.title: Covered, Not Contained
days.declaration: You are covered so that you can go, not so that you stay small.

scripture.text: He brought me out into a spacious place.

days.title: Safe Hands Only
days.declaration: May only safe hands hold you. May you learn early what safe feels like.

scripture.text: If anyone causes one of these little ones to stumble...

days.title: Prayed Over Nightly
days.declaration: You are prayed over most nights, including the ones nobody remembers.

scripture.text: Pray continually.

days.title: No Weapon Prevails
days.declaration: Things will be aimed at you in your life. None of them gets the last word.

scripture.text: No weapon forged against you will prevail.

days.title: A Firm Place to Stand
days.declaration: Before you can stand at all, you are standing on something solid.

scripture.text: He set my feet on a rock.

days.title: Guarded in the Small Hours
days.declaration: In the hardest hours of the night, you are guarded, and so are we.

scripture.text: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

days.title: Kept for a Whole Life
days.declaration: This covering is not for babyhood only. It is for eighty years if you have them.

scripture.text: Even to your old age and grey hairs I am he.

days.title: Kept
days.declaration: You are kept — deliberately, by someone who intends to hold on.

scripture.text: The Lord bless you and keep you.

days.title: Handed Into Safe Keeping
days.declaration: We are handing you into safer keeping than our own, every day, on purpose.

scripture.text: Father, into your hands I commit my spirit.
